title: The Elite Number Two and Tony Jackson
summary: At the Elite, owned by Tenan Jones who sold her a $40 ring she never paid, she worked with Tony Jackson, composer of "Pretty Baby".

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: You never mentioned that at all.
That's where I worked with Tony Jackson that wrote 'Pretty Baby'.
When did you work there? Before Panama?
After Dago Frank's was Hugh Hoskins.

And Hugh Hoskins was Elite Number Two, because I remember the first little diamond ring I got was a little, tiny ring -- the man Tenan (PHONETIC) Jones owned Elite, Numbers One and Two. And he had a little ring, he sold it to me for $40.00, and I never did pay him.

I conned him out of it, you know. So that's where I worked with Tony e X Jackson, who was a marvelous pianist. Marvelous pianist. And wrote some wonderful songs. He wrote, "Your Time Now is Going to Be Mine Some Sweet Day." He wrote, "Pretty Baby". He wrote -- oh, I can't remember all the songs.
But anyhow, Tony e X Jackson should be mentioned, because --
